Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync request: partner wants dual-licensed model (Community/Enterprise) listed + bundled with HW and SI. Need clear onboarding rules for license selection, SKU tagging, and what we can host vs link. cc @Connor (Legal)
Connor (Legal): High level: dual-licensing is fine but we must capture which license applies to which artifact. Community use -> link-only; Enterprise artifacts -> hosted + downloadable if partner permits. Need explicit `license_scope` per SKU.
Inez (Marketplace): SKU suggestion to encode license and bundle: `vendor.model.build.license.region.bundle` e.g., `helix-14b-q8-ENT-us-west-hwpack`. That avoids collisions in billing and search.
Gabe (HW): For HW bundle SKUs also include `hw_rev` and `si_partner`. Example: `helix-14b-q8-ENT-us-west-hwpack-v3-si-ursa`.
Ruth (Ops): Ops requires a signed manifest.json with fields: `spdx_id`, `license_url`, `license_scope` (community|enterprise), `allowed_derivatives` (none|patch|fork), `distribution_rights` (host|download|resell), `sha256`, `cert_thumbprint`, `export_classification`, `embargo_date`. We'll validate signature and checksum on ingest.
Connor (Legal): Important legal nuance: community-licensed artifacts often require attribution and may forbid commercial hosting. If `license_scope`=community we must refuse to host unless partner supplies explicit `enterprise_grant` for hosting. Also add `modification_level` for SI builds.
Maya (Partnerships): UX asks: show license pill on listing: "Community / Enterprise" with hover explaining what each allows. Also show "Hosted" vs "Link-only" and a provenance link to manifest.
Inez (Marketplace): Also expose a filter for `distribution_rights` and `allowed_derivatives` so enterprise customers can find fork-permissive builds. Search should default to enterprise-hosted when available.
Gabe (HW): Revenue split: when SI and HW are involved, we need a `revenue_tag` in manifest like `rev:hw:30,si:20,redwood:50`. Marketplace should honor per-SKU revenue splits.
Ruth (Ops): We'll record `revenue_tag` but ops won't enforce accounting; partnerships will wire to finance. We will surface it in the partner dashboard and billing export.
Connor (Legal): Draft clause to include in onboarding: ```Supplier grants Redwood the non-exclusive right to host and distribute Enterprise-scoped artifacts where Supplier marks `license_scope`=enterprise. Community-scoped artifacts remain link-only unless Supplier provides an `enterprise_grant`. Redistribution by downstream resellers requires explicit `distribution_rights`=resell and indemnity. Redwood to perform export vetting and may block distribution per `export_classification`.```
Maya (Partnerships): Cool. Action items: Connor -> finalize clause by Thu COB; Ruth -> manifest validator + SKU parser prototype by Fri; Inez -> UI license pill + filter mock by Fri; Gabe -> provide 3 HW bundle samples with revenue_tag by Wed.
Gabe (HW): Dropping samples: 1) `{"vendor":"lumen","model":"zen-7b","spdx":"Apache-2.0","license_scope":"community","distribution_rights":"link-only","sha256":"a1b2...","export_classification":"unrestricted"}` 2) `{"vendor":"lumen","model":"zen-7b","spdx":"Proprietary-Ent","license_scope":"enterprise","distribution_rights":"host,download","sha256":"c3d4...","revenue_tag":"rev:hw:25,si:15,redwood:60","export_classification":"unrestricted","embargo_date":"2026-07-15"}` 3) `{"vendor":"nova","model":"orbit-13b","spdx":"BSD-3","license_scope":"enterprise","distribution_rights":"host","allowed_derivatives":"patch","sha256":"f0e1...","export_classification":"restricted"}`
Ruth (Ops): Good samples. Note: sample 2 has `embargo_date` -> system will hold public listing until that date and show private preview to partners. MarketBot: Policy applied: embargo hold -> notify #partnerships when manifest validated. :robot_face:
Inez (Marketplace): UX note: when `distribution_rights` includes download, show a Download badge and require partner to confirm `download_license` (internal-only vs resell-ok). If resell-ok -> require indemnity checkbox in contract.
Connor (Legal): Agree. Also recommend we add machine-readable `license_spdx` and `license_text_url` in manifest to speed automated screening.
Maya (Partnerships): One operational edge-case: partner wants community tarball downloadable for research, enterprise hosted for paying customers. We should require separate build_tags and SKUs for each and clear mapping so there's no accidental leakage.
Ruth (Ops): We'll enforce separate SKUs per build_tag and block single artifact from having conflicting `license_scope` values. Validation rule added.
Gabe (HW): Last ask: SI-optimized builds sometimes need a different `perf_profile`. Please ensure SKU schema supports `perf_profile_tag` so marketing can show benchmarks per SKU.
Inez (Marketplace): Will add `perf_profile_tag` field to listing schema.
Maya (Partnerships): Great. Consensus on approach. I'll open partnership-ticket-10177 with the clause draft and sample manifests. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
Marketplace Bot: Note saved to partnership-ticket-10177 by Maya (Partnerships) at 3152468140.
